simple.meaning: אֲמָנָה (ʼămânâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “something fixed , i.e. a covenant . an allowance.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.short: something fixed , i.e. a covenant . an allowance
definitions.full: H548. amanah אֲמָנָה noun feminine faith, support . 1 אֲמָנָה כֹּרְתִים אֲנַחְנוּ we are plighting faith (make a sure covenant AV RV) Neh 10:1 . 2 ׳א המ ׳עַל support, fixed provision , for the singers Neh 11:23 .

occurrences.englishText: Now those who sealed were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,
For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.
